status: UNMEASURED planning model. Every quantity is an assumption until the I13 calibration run; prices marked verified were read from the cited pages on the stated date.

caps.owner_decision: 2026-09-29 (README R22); headroom target lowered from $100 to $50 on 2026-09-29 as an owner-accepted trade-off for choosing Pinecone (ADR-0029)

assumptions.region: us-east-1 (us-west-2 spot-checked on r7g.xlarge: same On-Demand, same Spot as displayed)
assumptions.demo_hours: 10 h/day, Mon-Fri = 217 h/month for scheduled Spot app nodes; data and system nodes 24x7 (730 h)

lean_lines.name: EKS control plane, 1 cluster (standard support)
lean_lines.note: Extended support is $0.60/h; keep the cluster on a supported Kubernetes version.

lean_lines.name: System node: 1 x t4g.large On-Demand (arm64, 2 vCPU, 8 GiB)
lean_lines.note: Aggregator shows 3 decimals. Burstable: watch CPU credits; fallback m7g.large On-Demand $0.082/h (+$11.0/month).

lean_lines.name: Data node: 1 x r7g.xlarge On-Demand (arm64, 4 vCPU, 32 GiB)
lean_lines.note: Stateful stores never on Spot. Replaces r7i.xlarge ($0.265/h). Graviton3 vCPU are cores, so CPU headroom is not worse; still UNMEASURED.

lean_lines.name: Spot app nodes: 2 x m7g.xlarge Spot, 217 h/month each (scheduled)
lean_lines.note: Spot figure moves (definition of the aggregator's Spot value not stated). m7i.xlarge Spot shown at $0.092: NodePool allows arm64 and amd64; priced at the higher. 217 h = 10 h x 5 weekdays x 52/12.

lean_lines.name: Sandbox pool: m7i.xlarge On-Demand, 30 h/month, scale from 0
lean_lines.note: On-Demand per I12 2.2 (no reclaim mid-execution). gVisor AMI is x86 for the demo.

lean_lines.name: GPU pool: g6.xlarge Spot, 80 GPU-hours/month (I12 budget, alarm at 80 h)
lean_lines.note: On-Demand $0.805/h. GPU stays x86 (vLLM/CUDA image). 80 h is the I12 2.2 cap, up from 40 h previously assumed in I00.

lean_lines.name: EBS gp3 storage, GB-month equivalent (235 persistent + prorated node roots)
lean_lines.note: Baseline 3,000 IOPS / 125 MB/s included. 235 GB persistent volumes + app roots 60 GB x 217/730 + GPU root 100 GB x 80/730 + sandbox root 50 GB x 30/730 = ~266.

lean_lines.name: EBS snapshots (Postgres, Cassandra, Kafka), ~100 GB stored
lean_lines.note: UNVERIFIED rate; verify at I13.

lean_lines.name: S3 Standard, ~300 GB with lifecycle (noncurrent expiry 30 d, abort multipart, Glacier IR after 90 d)
lean_lines.note: Intelligent-Tiering rejected: monitoring fee per object and no benefit at 300 GB.

lean_lines.name: S3 PUT/COPY/POST, 200,000 requests
S3 GET, 2,000,000 requests
NAT gateway, 1 (single-AZ demo)
lean_lines.note: Page label said US East (Ohio); NAT list price is the same in us-east-1. Also priced the same per AZ for Regional NAT.

lean_lines.name: NAT data processing, ~60 GB (S3 gateway endpoint takes ECR layer pulls off the NAT)
Public IPv4 for the NAT gateway EIP
lean_lines.note: Omitted in the previous plan.

lean_lines.name: ALB, 1
ALB LCU, assumed 0.5 LCU average
lean_lines.note: Traffic is an UNMEASURED assumption.

lean_lines.name: Public IPv4 for the ALB (2 AZ subnets)
lean_lines.note: Rate verified; that an ALB holds one public IPv4 per AZ is AWS behaviour not re-checked here. Omitted in the previous plan.

lean_lines.name: CloudWatch Logs ingestion, 10 GB (first 5 GB free)
lean_lines.note: EKS control-plane and audit logs only; volume UNMEASURED.

lean_lines.name: CloudWatch Logs storage, 10 GB
CloudWatch alarms, 15
CloudWatch custom metrics (GPU node-hour guard etc.), 5
KMS customer-managed keys, 6
KMS requests, 500,000/month less 20,000 free = 48 x 10k
Secrets Manager, 6 secrets (2 rotating DB credentials + 4 Pinecone API keys: tenant index writer, tenant index reader, public index reader, public curator); all other secrets in SSM Parameter Store
lean_lines.note: Pinecone keys are not auto-rotated; they sit in Secrets Manager per ADR-0029 (owner brief) rather than SSM.

lean_lines.name: Secrets Manager API calls (~18k/month via ESO)
Pinecone Standard, serverless (AWS us-east-1): $50/month minimum usage; demo usage is below the minimum, so the bill is the minimum
lean_lines.note: Minimum, storage $0.33/GB-month, writes ~$4/M and reads ~$16/M verified 2026-09-29 (page gives $4-$4.50 and $16-$18 by cloud/region; the low end is used, us-east-1 exact price not confirmed). Usage above is UNMEASURED and sits well under the minimum; if measured usage exceeds $50 the line becomes usage-priced. Starter (free) and the OpenSearch adapter cover dev and CI. PrivateLink needs Enterprise ($500/month), excluded.

lean_lines.name: SSM Parameter Store standard parameters (~25, SecureString via the KMS keys above)
lean_lines.note: Standard parameters are free; 4 KB limit, no rotation.

lean_lines.name: ECR private storage, ~30 GB (lifecycle keeps last 5 images per repo)
lean_lines.note: UNVERIFIED rate; same-Region pulls are free (verified on the ECR pricing page).

lean_lines.name: Route 53 zone, SQS/EventBridge for Karpenter interruptions, misc
lean_lines.note: UNVERIFIED lump sum.

lean_lines.name: Internet data transfer out (within the 100 GB/month free allowance)
lean_lines.note: The 100 GB monthly free allowance is verified; the $0.09/GB tier rate is from memory and is not used at 0 GB.

scenarios.description: I13-G3/G9 soak and certification month: scheduled scale-down disabled, app pool 24x7. After ADR-0029 this exceeds the $600 infrastructure cap (Pinecone minimum), so it is informational and needs an owner decision (README section 8 Q23).
Cert month with the app pool always-on for about 16.7 days (400 h per node) and scheduled otherwise; fits the cap with Pinecone Standard. A full 30-day G9 soak needs the owner decision in Q23.
Informational worst case: certification month and all 80 GPU-hours On-Demand ($0.805/h). Exceeds the cap, hence the GPU dollar alarm.

excluded_optional.item: AWS WAF on the ALB (Web ACL $5 + 3 rules $3 + 1M requests $0.60)
excluded_optional.reason: Prod/G2 only; the demo ALB uses a security-group allow-list plus gateway rate limits. Adding it uses part of the headroom. Owner decision.

excluded_optional.item: 1-year Compute Savings Plan on the data and system nodes
excluded_optional.reason: Optional, not relied on: commitment risk. Vantage 1-yr Reserved shows r7g.xlarge $0.142/h vs $0.214 On-Demand, but Savings Plan rates were not verified.

excluded_optional.item: Pinecone Enterprise plan for AWS PrivateLink and audit logs ($500/month minimum usage)
excluded_optional.reason: PrivateLink (Private Endpoints) requires the Enterprise plan. Production hardening item (I13); far outside the $1,000 demo budget. BYOC also needs Enterprise and its price is contact-sales (unpriced).

headroom_target_note: Owner-accepted 2026-09-29: choosing Pinecone Standard ($50/month minimum, ADR-0029) reduces headroom from $107.08 to $55.48. Do not lower further.
